steps.content: The darkness envelops you like a sodden, heavy blanket, smothering your mouth and nose. Each breath feels thick and viscous, as if you're drowning in air.
You struggle desperately, but an invisible force pins your limbs in place. You can't move even a fingertip.
[Release the shackles]
It's useless. The dark red glow barely flickers to life before going out like a short-circuiting current. Refusing to give up, you try once more.
[Release the shackles]
Still doesn't work. This place is even capable of suppressing your power.
Even your last weapon has been disarmed, leaving you to experience nothing but complete darkness and isolation. No light exists here. Sound barely travels. Even time itself feels like dried tar.
You've been double-crossed by the Clergyman!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Clergyman! Answer me! I know you're there!

Bang, bang, bang. The tiny sealed space shudders with your pounding, but you're unsure if the noise can reach the Clergyman. Fortunately, a voice finally comes through from the other side of the darkness.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: This is a "jail" made by the creator, situated within a rift completely isolated from this world. The Witch fears you, so she's using these extreme measures to keep you contained.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: But don't worry, I won't let any harm come to you. The jail only functions while the game is running, and there's not much time left.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: Once her cycle reaches its end and the Witch fulfills her wish, you'll be able to leave safely. I promise you that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Clergyman, don't tell me you...
A string of familiar laughter rings out from outside, coming from right beside the Clergyman.
You can almost visualize it. Just as the Witch's shadow once appeared beside the Butcher, right now, an identical shadow must be standing right next to the Clergyman!

As the Witch draws near, the air around you begins to warp. The Mania, imperceptible to you before, now becomes almost tangible. The door separating you from the Clergyman vanishes, leaving only darkness. Objects in the room break free from gravity and float in the air, including you. Is she going to kill you?
But another voice stops her.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: Don't harm him. Once the cycle ends, let him go. That was our deal.
steps.female_content: Don't harm her. Once the cycle ends, let her go. That was our deal.

steps.content: The Witch's laughter ceases abruptly. She doesn't respond, but the force restraining you loosens, and the Mania in the jail gradually subsides.
You realize it was the Clergyman who came to your defense. He's just on the other side of this darkness, perhaps watching you right now.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: I'm sorry, Chief. I never wanted to betray you like this. Being seen by you, being considered your friend... That truly means a lot to me. I really wanted to help you.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: But, sorry... Someone had already reached out to me before you did, offering me a friendship I treasure deeply. That's why I must prioritize her wish over yours.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You mean that Witch? That Sinner who controls Mania?

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: No, I mean that girl who smiles as she guides every newcomer into Cirrenfold.
[Flashback: First Meeting & Worship]

steps.speaker: Prima
steps.content: Oh, I see. You're feeling homesick, aren't you?

steps.speaker: Prima
steps.content: Don't worry. Soon, the Witch will be found.
[End of Flashback]

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: Indeed, I know nothing about Sinners or Mania. I can't be certain she's being completely honest with me.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: But I know exactly what an "insincere smile" looks like. Because that's how I smile.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: Day after day, endlessly putting on the same practiced, fake smile for my colleagues, clients, and people who forget each other the moment they part ways... I know that all too well, which is why I treasure the time she gives me.
...But is anything truly sincere in this fictional town filled with fictional identities and fictional values?
You resist the urge to contradict him outright, focusing instead on thinking through the situation.
You thought the Clergyman would be more reasonable than the Butcher, but he turns out to be far more delusional than you could have imagined.
At least the Butcher was only controlled by the Witch's shadow, but the Clergyman has a real "witch" right by his side.
You can't break out of this dark jail alone. No matter how difficult, winning over the Clergyman remains your only viable option.
But the owner of the jail seems to sense your internal conflict and interrupts with a smile.

steps.speaker: Prima??
steps.content: You're so convinced that you alone are his true friend, constantly claiming you need him, trust him, want to break the Witch's lies and bring him back to reality...

steps.speaker: Prima??
steps.content: So... do you still remember the real name of this Clergyman?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Shut up... Stop speaking through someone else's body!
[Flashback] Hot Spring Pool

steps.speaker: Female Student
steps.content: Since they put us in the same room, we might end up as a team! Let's introduce ourselves. I'm <color=#fb9259>Eleanor</color>, freshman at Eastside University! What about you all?
You hesitate for a moment before answering.
The shadow across from you tuts incredulously, seemingly surprised that you still remember despite having "died" so many times.
You had always called him Clergyman up until now.

steps.speaker: Prima??
steps.content: Wrong answer! Hahaha! Look, Ezra, he doesn't even remember your name. How can he still claim to be your friend?
steps.female_content: Wrong answer! Hahaha! Look, Ezra, she doesn't even remember your name. How can she still claim to be your friend?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait! Ezra!
Ezra seems neither annoyed nor resentful.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: It's alright, Chief. Clergyman or Glasses, call me whatever you like. What matters is not my name. You've already given me enough recognition and shared with me something truly precious—your care and friendship.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: If you still want me as your companion, why not trust me one more time?
The presence of Mania grows heavier as the Clergyman's voice grows unstable, triggering waves of echoes within your skull.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: After everything that's happened, how can you still say that...
Before you can make a decision, the Witch's laughter cuts in.

steps.speaker: Prima??
steps.content: The sand in the hourglass is almost running out, and so is time!

steps.speaker: Prima??
steps.content: Those who yearn to break free from the cycle must pass the Witch's Trial. That is my duty, the eternal cycle of this world.

steps.speaker: Prima??
steps.content: You'll help me, won't you?

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: Of course. I've found my friends here, and I want them all to fulfill their wishes.
As the Witch speaks, pitch-black Mania compresses the already cramped space, pressing down on you until even remaining upright becomes a struggle.

steps.speaker: Prima??
steps.content: Just a moment. It won't take long...
She raises her hand, altering the spatial structure linking you. In an instant, you're thrust far away, sinking into palpable darkness...
You unleash your shackles, shooting out crimson spikes of light, but they touch nothing. The darkness seems to be adapting to your power, infinitely expanding and evading your every strike.
She has created an almost infinite darkness just for you. Even her laughter will soon fade away as she forsakes you in this boundless, deathly silence.
No matter how you rage and scream, they are determined to keep you imprisoned here.
[Screen Shakes + Blade Flash Effect]
Boom! A flash of steel splits your closing field of vision as blood-red moonlight pours in. The heavy door explodes into splinters, shooting like darts toward the Clergyman!
The splinters of wood pierce his back and arms sharply. Blood gushes out instantly.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: Mmph!
[Insert special effects and sound effects]
You see before you hear the ax. The blade sweeps past the Clergyman's body, spraying blood everywhere in the confined space.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: What an exciting turn of events, and you left me out again? That is so unfair!
Bathed in moonlight, Eleanor appears at the doorway, wielding that long ax you once abandoned. Without waiting for the Clergyman's reaction, she fiercely swings for a second strike!
Slash...!
The Witch's shadow dissolves like foam next to the Clergyman as a deep, long gash opens across his back. He crashes heavily to the ground.
Eleanor seems utterly unbothered by what she's done and breaks into raucous laughter.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Aha! I get it now! So this is how you play the game! You've got these... skills. You just need to find your own role first...

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: I want a role too! I want the Witch's guidance! But not just something boring...

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>I want to... <size=44>become the Witch</size>!</color>
Eleanor clutches the long ax as tendrils of Mania snake up her arm from the weapon. In the pool of blood at her feet, the Clergyman's gaze grows unfocused as he trembles, reaching a hand toward you.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: No...
Eleanor swings the ax, its blade carving an arc in the air before crashing down with a loud clang! The Clergyman's body rapidly transforms into wax and vanishes.
Eleanor curiously examines the spot where the Witch's shadow disappeared. Nothing remains.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Isn't she supposed to be the Witch? Why isn't anything happening? Did my strike not land properly?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Eleanor, stop!
You finally find your voice again and desperately pound against the transparent barrier, but your shouts are swallowed by the jail.
Only then does Eleanor finally notice you, trapped in darkness with a look of shock on your face.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Oh my god, how did you get locked up in there? Don't worry! I'll get you out!

She swings the ax, and the jail's seal shatters instantly. You tumble forward onto the ground, your palms sinking into something sticky and red. You look up to find yourself staring into those same gray, cloudy eyes that once met yours confidently, now vacant and lifeless.
She grips your wrist tightly, her eyes gleaming with wild excitement.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: You have a special power, don't you? I saw it... When you killed the Butcher, did those spikes come out of your hand?

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Hehe, do you think... I can become the Witch if I kill her?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Put down the ax. The Mania has gotten into you!

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Exactly! If I had the Witch's power, I wouldn't have to play this boring looping game anymore! You want to kill the Witch too, don't you? This is perfect!

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Let's go kill the real Witch, and then... I'll take her place!
Eleanor is now completely controlled by Mania. She won't listen to anything you say. Her eyes show nothing but madness and ambition.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: I promise I'll do what you say. Let's play for 24 hours... No! 72 hours! Once I've had enough fun, I'll leave! What's graduation and job hunting compared to this? This is way more fun!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eleanor, don't let the Mania take control! This isn't the real you. Remember why you came here in the first place!

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Why I came...? I came for a thrilling game! Right, this is... all just a game, silly. Just do whatever pleases you!

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Are you not enjoying yourself? If you're suffering so much... how about I send you back with a swing of my ax?
[Insert special portrait - Schoolgirl nameplate change]
The name tag on Eleanor's chest is glowing faintly. The text on it twists and distorts, erased by an invisible force. It's changed from "Adventurer" into Witch's "Devotee."
Sensing the eerie transformation happening in her, her face flushes with excitement like a burning sunset, revealing a bone-chilling madness.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>What is this feeling...? Have I finally... passed the "Witch's Trial"?<i></color>

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>Are you there? Witch... you're summoning me, aren't you? You can grant my wishes, right?<i></color>
As if sensing something, Eleanor releases you. She narrows her eyes, her gaze piercing the misty forest and the eerie town, searching for something in the distance.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>She's waiting for me... I must find her...<i></color>
Where is she going? Does she know where the Witch is?

You reach out to grab Eleanor's arm, but she shakes you off without even looking back. Dragging her ax, she rushes excitedly out of the room, chasing after what she senses in her mind—the location of the Witch!
You follow closely behind her.
[Change background to forest. Add footstep sounds and shadow effects]

Some things are becoming clear now. In this game, the name tags are very important. Once a participant gets a role, they gain their own exclusive <color=#fb9259>skill</color>, enhancing their experience and allowing them to adventure freely.

The Butcher wants to protect others, so he needs great strength. That's why his skill is Unstoppable Force. The Clergyman craves others' respect and recognition, so he needs to be excellent at communication. That's why his skill is Supreme Affinity.
As for Eleanor, who had been playing as herself, she has finally found the role and power she desires. She's become the Witch's Devotee, which means her skill will guide her straight to the Witch!
You sprint through the pitch-black forest, struggling to keep up with Eleanor's unnaturally fast pace.
Dark silhouettes emerge from the shadows, swarming around you. Blood-red moonlight filters through the branches as the Witch's laughter follows you like a shadow, surrounding you in stereo.

steps.speaker: Witch's Shadow
steps.content: Hehe... Angry, are you?

steps.speaker: Witch's Shadow
steps.content: Leaving so soon? The story isn't over yet.
[Hourglass Effect]
The hourglass's illusion flashes past your vision. The cycle is about to reset.
You know that once everything restarts, the square will again fill with people, and the sacrificial ritual will play out once more... And this time, who will stand on the circular platform?
When that happens, all the stubborn players will come back to life. The Butcher, the Clergyman, Eleanor... They'll do everything in their power to stop you!
The rage burning in your heart isn't directed at any single person, but at this absurd game, at the rules that treat humans as pawns and lives as mere playthings!
At this very moment, a searing pain throbs in your chest. It's the name tag. It's burning and transforming too.

When the Butcher swung his ax, when the Clergyman comforted you, and when Eleanor found her new role... Their nametags all glowed when they acted weird. Clearly, embracing a role means surrendering yourself to this story!
You tear off your name tag, its text distorting and shaking as it heats up. Before it can affect you, you hurl it to the ground.
You will never let these rules control you.
[Cycle through several town street and square backgrounds, with the Witch's shadowed portrait floating left and right to show movement between locations]
After running for a long time, passing the town's flagstone streets and the misty forest, you discover Eleanor's destination is actually the starting point of your journey—the hot spring inn.
Prima isn't a player, so she shouldn't be able to respawn in the hot spring bath like the rest of you. Then why... would she be here?
But then you remember her damp hair and that familiar fragrance during your first meeting, and everything suddenly makes sense.
She plays the role of an innocent girl, helping new players immerse themselves in the game quickly. She journeys alongside you, extracts information from you, and probes the emptiness in your heart.
When she finally discovers what you are seeking here, that's when she begins tailoring the story for you, entrapping you...
[Scene Transition] Hot Spring Inn Lobby
You climb the steps, pass through the garden, and enter the lobby. Someone is sitting on that familiar red velvet sofa.
[Prima's portrait appears, eyes squinting as she smiles]
Her hair clings wetly to her neck, while Rumina stands silently behind her, gently patting it dry with a towel.

Seeing you arrive, Rumina immediately stops, stepping aside while tucking the towel away. Unlike before, Seon doesn't greet you cheerfully, but instead hides behind Rumina's hair as if caught doing something bad.
As for Eleanor, she has set down her ax and lies prostrated at the Witch's feet, just like a true devotee.
Prima appears just as she did when you first met, tilting her head innocently in a simple white dress, as if she can't understand why you've burst in so angrily.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Found you finally, Prima. Or should I call you... <color=#fb9259>Witch</color>.
[Release Shackles] Special Effect

Expecting her to dodge, you're ready to redirect your shackles quickly. But she doesn't evade or resist. She even raises her hand to stop the eager Eleanor, and with an almost welcoming posture, deliberately offers herself to the piercing light of your shackles.
The crimson light pierces directly through her chest, tearing her body apart and ripping open a black fissure.
[Insert CG] kv-Creation-ClosedEyes-AnimatedCG
A figure is <color=#fb9259>born</color> from the fissure.
She has appeared in your every dying moment, her gaze licking along your spine from the darkness.
Ahhh...
In an instant, gold, red, and green light erupts. Instead of diffusing outward, it stretches open the space aggressively, creating a magnificent yet unsettling scene.
At the center of this otherworldly radiance, the legendary Witch smiles, a barely perceptible curve of her lips that is overwhelmingly commanding.
The true <color=#fb9259>Witch of Rewind</color> manifests herself amid your burning rage.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: The brave Voyager, walked on and on, luggage getting lighter along the way.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: He cut down the Butcher who only knew violence, abandoned the Clergyman who wished to protect his friends. Even the Adventurer left him to become a mere Witch's Devotee.
steps.female_content: She cut down the Butcher who only knew violence, abandoned the Clergyman who wished to protect his friends. Even the Adventurer left her to become a mere Witch's Devotee.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Oh, what a storyteller you are. Heh, perhaps if I lent you my pen, you might write a more interesting plot twist?
The Witch's voice drifts ethereally, carrying a hypnotic rhythm that leaves you slightly intoxicated.
Between sobriety and confusion, you only register a cool yet soft sensation on your lips. Her index finger is gently pressing against them with some kind of secret approval.
She hovers toward you like a swaying flower, a smile playing on her lips. Your eyes meet hers for just a moment, and you find yourself unable to look away.
Her fingertips reach for the back of your hanging hand, where a faint triangular mark remains. When you got it, she was still Prima. With a delicate touch, she reclaims it.
Then her fingers climb up your arm, gliding to your shoulder, applying barely any pressure, just the ghost of her fingertips tracing the contours of your neck.

As you reach out to push her away, she touches your wrist with her fingertips, suddenly retreats, then approaches from another angle. Her warm breath flutters toward your face, carrying the distinctive incense fragrance of a hot spring inn.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Thirty minutes until the story ends, my guest. Why the hurry?
